setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The council speculates that distant villages might exchange messages instantly across seas.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Separated relatives could speak despite the distance, the villagers suppose.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A young person wonders whether constant contact would make leaving home harder.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A false warning might travel farther than anyone could correct it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A healer suggests verifying messages before passing them along.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A fisherman cherishes a shore where no one can summon him.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another villager imagines such communication as a lifeline during emergencies.
